  "text": "On Monday morning, Mara found the shop key in the pocket of the coat she had worn to the hospital. A paper parking ticket came out with it. She put the ticket back.

‘Will you be doing the work yourself?’

‘Yes.’

He released the jacket. She could not tell whether she had reassured him.

On Tuesday, she moved the stool closer to the machine. Her knees no longer struck the underside of the table, but the pedal sat too far away. She knelt and pulled it towards her, disturbing a small grey drift of lint.

Under the pedal lay a shirt button. She put it in the saucer with the others."
